items.title: Keep copy-quality gates precise for legitimate published prose
items.why: Actual source run3 failed at362 on the upstream October30 story: non-denial denial, WIRED and placeholder as a metaphor. Inspection proves three false positives rather than malformed editorial copy.
items.recipe: Correct doubled-word matching at complete hyphenated-word boundaries, recognize WIRED in the existing all-caps brand allowlist, and distinguish the ordinary noun placeholder from explicit publishing markers. Keep true duplicate, shouting, bracketed/uppercase/standalone stub and other placeholder detectors active. Preserve article prose and add positive/negative regression fixtures in the existing self-test.
items.acceptance: Actual corpus passes without changing its article text. Existing54 self-tests plus explicit positive/negative boundary, brand and publishing-marker regressions pass. Genuine repeated words, unknown shouted words, and explicit placeholder stubs still fail. Independent review passes before source/full release acceptance.
items.userOutcome: Readers retain correct reporting and attribution while the release gate still catches genuine publishing defects.
items.stageRationale: A demonstrated required source-gate failure prevents the authorized release; fix the verifier at its actual false-positive boundaries.
